how_to_use: This is the canonical Bhutan ops lookup. Filter `type` (hotel | homestay | guide | vehicle | attraction). Columns: name, address, phone, email, url, photos, subtype. `details` holds rates/rooms/licenses. Per-type files remain the richer source if a field is empty here.

coverage.hotels: Silverpine dump ~99 unique hotels — not the full DOT hotel directory (~203+).
coverage.homestays: DOT certified VHS 123 + 4 extra licensed portal profiles.
coverage.guides: Silverpine dump ~100 guides — national pool is much larger. Gender is heuristic.
coverage.vehicles: Hire categories only; no named public driver roster. Chauffeur included.
coverage.attractions: Library activities + entry-fee sites + local entry-point photos.
